surface.sig_requirement: Sig normalizes to one exact function signature type
surface.grammar_route: QualifiedType plus existing TypeArgs and function Type

exact_signature_identity_fields: ordered parameter channel and ownership modes

normalization.hir_rule: retain the normalized exact function-type identity; facade spelling is CST-only
normalization.api_digest_rule: hash the exact normalized signature fields, never the word Callable alone
normalization.mir_rule: use the selected exact callable identity and ordinary INVOKE path

compatibility_and_invocation.assignment: identical to the normalized exact function signature
compatibility_and_invocation.variance: existing exact function-type variance and row-subsumption law
compatibility_and_invocation.invocation: identical CallPlan, CallableImplementationId and call-right checks as Sig

rejections: Callable with more than one type argument
Callable<T> where T is not an exact function signature
Callable<any Trait> or another erased/dynamic signature
conversion that drops an error, effect, ownership, call-right, isolation, context or witness field

acceptance.positive: Callable<(Int) -> String throws IOError> is type-identical to that exact signature and invokes through its exact responsibility
acceptance.boundary: aliases and generic substitutions are fully normalized before the one-signature check
acceptance.reject: bare, non-function, erased, or responsibility-dropping facade use emits one diagnostic and creates no callable HIR identity
